No Part D drug plan because you take few or no prescriptions? Going 63 days or more without creditable drug coverage after you were first eligible can add a late enrollment penalty to your Part D premium, usually for as long as you have Part D. Annual enrollment runs through Dec 7. We can check whether your current coverage counts and compare drug plans with you. Call (571) 354-0146.

We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information we provide is limited to those plans we do offer in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
